name: photoshop-control
description: Control an existing Windows Photoshop session through native COM; no Creative Cloud, panel or developer tools required.

interface.longDescription: Discover existing Windows Photoshop sessions, inspect documents and layers, and execute authorized JSX through native COM. No Photoshop-side installation is required. Same-installation multi-process routing is explicitly refused.
defaultPrompt: 连接 Photoshop 并查看打开的文档
